compiled_state.title: Test types + draft_hash source: extend append-review-cycle fixture to assert field types and hash computation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
DD1 (21f3) remediation: each cycles[] entry must have field types asserted (n=int, findings_count=int, verdict=enum) AND draft_hash must be verifiably computed over the producer's DELTA OUTPUT block (not an opaque CLI arg).

## Scope

Extend either tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh or tests/scripts/test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh (or create a small additional fixture) to add the following assertions:

1. **Field types** — after an append:
   - cycles[0].n is JSON number (int)
   - cycles[0].findings_count is JSON number (int)
   - cycles[0].verdict is one of {pass, fail, escalate}

2. **draft_hash computation contract** — verify that draft_hash is the sha256 of a defined input block (the producer's DELTA OUTPUT). The test should:
   a. Construct a known DELTA OUTPUT string (e.g., '=== DELTA OUTPUT ===\\n[...]')
   b. Compute its sha256: `expected=$(printf %s "$DELTA" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1)` (or use python3 hashlib)
   c. Call append_review_cycle.py with --draft-hash "$expected"
   d. Assert the stored draft_hash equals $expected AND has the format of a 64-char hex sha256 (regex: ^[a-f0-9]{64}$)

This is a documentation/contract test — append_review_cycle.py treats draft_hash as a string and stores it verbatim. The test verifies the CALLER-SIDE contract: that callers pass an actual sha256 of the DELTA OUTPUT block.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] Fixture file exists and is executable
- [ ] Asserts n field is int type
- [ ] Asserts findings_count field is int type
- [ ] Asserts verdict field is one of {pass, fail, escalate}
- [ ] Asserts draft_hash is a 64-char lowercase hex string (sha256 format)
- [ ] Asserts at least one test case computes sha256 of a known DELTA OUTPUT block and confirms the writer stores it correctly
- [ ] Run: bash <fixture> → PASS
- [ ] Non-regression: test-append-review-cycle.sh, test-append-review-cycle-concurrent.sh, test-review-cycles-end-to-end.sh all still PASS

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus, escalate to user
